description: Use this when the user asks how many visitors AI assistants sent to their website. Whether the app's website script is installed (status), and what it counted from AI assistants over the last days (UTC): visits per assistant, clicks to the App Store or Google Play after one, purchases the site reported, by day, and the pages people landed on. Google AI Mode and AI Overviews refer from google.com and aren't counted here.
name: ai_referrals
title: Visitors from AI assistants
